svg.title: Transcardial perfusion: flush with PBS, then fix with PFA
svg.desc: A schematic of the heart with vessels running to the brain, a DRG beside the spinal cord, and the colon. Blood fills the vessels; a needle goes into the left ventricle; cold PBS from bottle 1 flushes the blood out of every vessel; then PFA from bottle 2 flows through the same clean vessels and the brain, DRG and colon are fixed (hatched) all at once.
